messages:
oncall-bot: Pager — Elevated 5xx and 429 rates on /v1/token/introspect and /v1/embeddings (sustained). Severity: high. Link: https://console.redwood/alerts/1765432100 :rotating_light:

maria (oncall-sre): I’m looking. 5xxs from the introspect service and token validation timeouts, also huge spike in requests to embeddings from many IPs. Could be credential stuffing or misconfigured crawler.

sam (security): seeing repeated failed auth attempts across many tokens, pattern looks like password/token spray. Indicators: many distinct IP subnets, same user-agents like "python-requests/2.31" and repeated small payloads.

kai (devex): customers complaining about slowness on hosted embeddings. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood/metrics/embed-latency shows tail latency up x6.

maria (oncall-sre): First mitigation: enable stricter rate limit policy for unauthenticated endpoints and token introspect. I’m applying the temporary policy now: `rlp-temporary-strict-2026-03-15` -> limits: 20 requests/min per IP, 10 requests/min per token.

ops-nerd: +1. Also I’m going to add WAF rule to block observed user-agent patterns and known abusive ASN ranges. Will push rule id `waf-1765-block-bots`.

pg-deploy-bot: Deploy initiated by ops-nerd: waf-rules/v2 -> prod (canary 15%).

maria (oncall-sre): Commands I ran (audit log):
```
# tighten per-ip rate limits
redwoodctl rate-limits update --policy rlp-temporary-strict-2026-03-15 --scope unauthenticated
# lock token introspect throughput
redwoodctl rate-limits update --policy rlp-token-introspect-locked --token-scope 10/m
```

sam (security): Added IP blocks for the top 12 abusive /24s and blacklisted 3 suspicious ASNs: `AS36351`, `AS16509`, `AS45102`. Also enabled challenge (CAPTCHA) on suspect traffic via WAF challenge rule.

kai (devex): Noted a side effect: some legit SDK customers using shared proxies might see 429s. We should whitelist verified partners. I’ll post a note in #support to preempt tickets.

ethan (prod): Customer impact estimate: ~12% of hosted embeddings traffic was from scraped/bot sources; after rate limits & WAF started at 1765432500 we see overall 5xxs dropping and 429s rising (expected). Key paying customers: 3 accounts had degraded throughput for 10–20 minutes due to token-level throttling.

maria (oncall-sre): Rolling back overly-aggressive token block for tokens that show valid usage patterns. Scripted query to identify tokens to whitelist: `scripts/whitelist-legit-tokens.py --since 1765430000`.

sam (security): Observed credential stuffing attempts targeting the token refresh endpoint (low-volume per token but high cardinality). Recommend temporary disable of anonymous embedding uploads and require token auth for new embedding jobs.

ops-nerd: Flipping feature flag `embeddings-public-uploads` -> off. Command: `featureflag set embeddings-public-uploads false --reason "mitigation 1765432100"`.

kai (devex): Posted a short advisory in #status with guidance for customers and a link to the temporary mitigation FAQ. Snippet: "We've deployed targeted rate limits and WAF defenses for suspicious traffic. If you're seeing 429s and are a legitimate partner, follow the whitelist instructions or contact support." :information_source:

maria (oncall-sre): Monitoring impact now. CPU for token-introspect pods normalized. KV cache hit-rate improved after blocking heavy token spray. Charts: https://dash.redwood/queries/1765432100

ethan (prod): Confirmed major customers A and B saw reduced errors after whitelisting. Customer C had a short disruption; CS reached out proactively.

pg-deploy-bot: Canary to 100% completed for `waf-1765-block-bots` at 1765433105.

sam (security): We should capture the spray artifacts for forensics. I’m collecting pcap/log bundles and will open a ticket with threat intel: `TI-2026-1765`.

maria (oncall-sre): Handoff: I need to go offline for parenting duty in ~30m. @sam take the incident lead for next shift and @kai continue customer comms.

sam (security): Ack — taking lead. Oncall contact pinned. I’ll coordinate with legal if customer data exposure suspected.

kai (devex): Support note posted. Slack triage doc: https://confluence.redwood/incidents/1765432100-mitigation. Template includes rollback steps and whitelist flow.

maria (oncall-sre): Final status at 1765436000: traffic back to baseline, 5xxs resolved, 429s present but controlled. Incident downgraded to monitoring.

sam (security): Post-incident actions (short): [1] refine token-introspect rate-limits by token-entropy & client reputation, [2] automate ASN blocklist ingestion, [3] create quick whitelist flow for partners, [4] run postmortem and upload artifacts.

ethan (prod): I’ll open a customer-impact doc for the three affected accounts and coordinate credits if needed.

kai (devex): Leaving notes for follow-up on SDKs to avoid shared-proxy footguns.

maria (oncall-sre): Thanks team. Logging final message and closing channel for active mitigation. Will create postmortem with timelines and mitigation commands. :white_check_mark:

sam (security): Collected logs uploaded: https://secure.redwood/forensics/TI-2026-1765.zip — flagged for IR review.

ops-nerd: Added playbook snippet for similar future events: `playbooks/abuse/spray-mitigation.md`.

pg-deploy-bot: Incident closed by maria (oncall-sre) at 1765438200."
